correctness.rationale: Every initially nonzero three-periodic state on a connected graph advances at every vertex and is exactly a successor-supported 3-coloring. At fixed root color the rooted-block boundary partition is complete and disjoint. The nine local ordered phase pairs yield (5,6,2) and (4,4,1) polynomials with base (2,1), so P_h=3A_h. The log recurrence gives an absolutely convergent entropy series. Bounds r_h>=121/170 for h>=1, q(r_0)=17/2 and q(r_h)>10 establish c>(log 340)/4>log(2+sqrt5). Independently replayed Python local symbolic enumeration and exhaustive 14,351,121-state C++ GH dynamics agree at h<=2. Finite data do not certify general h; the symbolic case split does.

value.rationale: A tree has no GHM sustained excitation, but its line graph creates triangular feedback at each branch. The exact all-height binary-block census and limiting entropy answer a natural structural graph-transformation question. The proved strict entropy improvement over a linear chain of equal-size triangular blocks quantifies the effect of branching; neither a routine small count nor a numerical-only trend.
